title: Cap. X Arg. V: therefore election/predestination and preterition/reprobation do not hang on antecedent foresight of faith or unbelief — they precede such foresight
pass_a_gloss: Election or predestination, and preterition or reprobation, do not hang from antecedent foresight of faith and of perseverance in certain ones, and of unbelief and of pertinacity in others, but precede such foresight.
pass_b_english: So election — that is, predestination — and preterition — that is, reprobation — do not hang on antecedent foresight of faith and perseverance in some, and of unbelief and pertinacity in others. They precede that foresight.
source_text: Electio sive praedestinatio, et praeteritio sive reprobatio non pendent ex praevisione antecedanea fidei et perseverantiae in quibusdam, ac infidelitatis et pertinaciae in aliis, sed talem praevisionem antecedunt.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. X Arg. V cont. section 722. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap10_arg5_densify.
